test_title: PYST 33: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/683d3beabe6a049a3e6208d5dcf0478a8d517b3da25deb6c8b4628b4d3260edf.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For 'V' element → 

 
• Shifting forward and backward alternately.
 
• Rotation of 90º anti-clockwise alternately.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18f998409a9656410a2893485bfe83f434c8fc63edeeaa69c632c98567340514.png] 

2) For ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/298cfed3cf8d51ed49a1a66c95cc0959193e11f9b90e80ecc5fc941286e92bb6.png] ' element → 

 
• Shifting backward and forward alternately.
 
• Rotation of 90º anti-clockwise alternately.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91edd3d3acbc6dfae69fbf975165f10612a3e0b8f566b824099f9d856b66a460.png] 

3) For ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c55a91914956006660e03dd3226851462adcbd6f31d0cb4de6978d7169af9b46.png] ' element →

 
• Shifting in clockwise direction alternately.
 
• Rotation of 90º clockwise alternately. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1817b426d510be1d9908fbf39b6fd24eb48edf42d60ce3f4e3fa6bce7d6726f.png] 

4) For ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fdef9b302f4764c2500d2cd961614d7446a64c854ab3b3f9b21b179b01879d6.png] ' element →

 
• Shifting clockwise direction alternately.
 
• Flipping upside down alternately and then rotation of 90º clockwise. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7312d8d0b228646cc246a07ca0655f7cba64b9283241c7ca0927b863c4a658ea.png] 

5) For 'T' element →

 
• Shifting clockwise direction alternately.
 
• Rotation of 90º clockwise alternately.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64318a5b465144a9604240908160bfe011feb26ccfd35bf65412d82022cb290f.png] 

Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cd2c13e4d7a6f5a1fc2bc7ff5559d5087847217d91f4b367f8d16cc5edca3ba.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.
